top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs the Kane-Mele prediction of the quantum spin Hall state and Z2 classification with Molenkamp's first experimental observation in HgTe quantum wells. It is a mature, independently confirmed discovery with a clean prediction-to-observation causal chain, a defensible three-person allocation, and a citation scoped to what these laureates did. Optical lattice clocks (P002) are also mature and cleanly attributed, so I rank them second, ahead of no award.
